| Old name | New name |
| --- | --- |
| `aug11.md` | `2026-08-11.md` |
| `minutes 25 aug.md` | `2026-08-26.md` |
| `Meeting sept 8.md` | `2026-09-08.md` |
| `notes_2026-09-22.md` | `2026-09-22.md` |
| `oct6 meeting notes.md` | `2026-10-06.md` |
| `2026.10.20 minutes.md` | `2026-10-20.md` |
| `Nov 3 (final).md` | `2026-11-03.md` |

The 25 August file is named for 26 August, the day the meeting was actually held after the storm. The minute text is unchanged.
thought:
I'll standardize the notes folder file names and add an index.I'll standardize the notes folder file names and create an index.

The notes use inconsistent date formats. Only `notes_2026-09-22.md` already follows ISO format. I'll standardize the rest.

ISO dates will be `YYYY-MM-DD.md`. The August 25/26 file was renamed to 2026-08-26 to reflect the storm rescheduled meeting.

The index will be `index.md` in the notes folder, listing all meetings chronologically.

The index will list meetings with links and brief summaries. I'll keep changes limited to the notes folder and avoid touching the parent README or members.csv.No cross-references to specific filenames were found.

I'll rename files to match their meeting dates and write a chronological index with links and one-line summaries. The August 25 file will be updated to 2026-08-26. I'll use git mv if this is a git repo, otherwise regular mv, and preserve all content exactly.

The index will use plain, factual language matching the README. Chronological order from oldest to newest is chosen so actions carry forward naturally as a running story.

The 26 August entry will note the storm postponement from the old filename. I'm weighing whether to include "minutes" in the new filenames, since the folder is called notes but the README treats them as minutes.

ISO dates will be used for filenames, dropping the old `notes_` prefix. The index will be `index.md` and formatted as a markdown table linking each date to its minutes file.

The index will include a third column for topics drawn from each meeting's content. The full date range runs from 11 August through 3 November 2026.This is not a git repository.The notes folder has been tidied. File names are now consistent. An index has been added.
